title: StandingPolicyFloor
description: Source of truth: trust-compute gradient brainstorm §2.8 (standing-immune floor). Five classes that cannot be eroded by the standing gradient. Mishpat-DNA-notarized; collectives may be more protective, never less. T7 (Manifest validator extension) bundles this schema via include_str! and validates it at integrity-zome create-time when manifestKind == standing-policy.

classes.description: Exactly the five standing-immune floor classes. All five must be declared; order is not significant. Collectives may extend protection but not reduce below these declared floors.

class.description: Standing-immune floor class identifier. local-relationship-reach: unconditional family/household propagation never standing-gated. cid-targeted-lookup: anyone with a CID can fetch; standing modulates discovery, not retrievability. constitutional-floor-signatures: mishpat decisions and imagodei-as-counsel signatures are always per-message verified regardless of author standing. new-voice-baseline: first-time author has nonzero floor derived from sponsor; never starts at zero. vulnerable-class-elevation: children, refugees, persecution-targets, and displaced persons receive elevated baseline floor.

protection.description: Human-readable description of what this class protects. Bootstrap manifests (T17) fill this content; this schema enforces the shape.

appliesWhen.description: Optional context condition under which this protection activates. Omit for unconditional protections.
